Extracts article:published_time, modified_time, author, section, and tags

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(null);
        String url = "https://example.com";
        var result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url);
        System.out.println(result.statusCode());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().article().publishedTime());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().article().modifiedTime());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().article().author());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().article().section());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().article().tags().size());
    }
}
```
